notes: Corrected: the supplied *hath* was moved out of the `עַל` unit and marked `added`. `עַל` already holds the written *upon*, so under rule 43's counting paragraph it is not a home for a second English word, and no other morpheme in the clause makes it possessive.
The double realization of `אֱלוֹהַּ` as *God ... him* is retained under rule 25 and the alternative is named in that unit's note (rule 8).
The marginal *Hebrew gold* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
